answer: Entry needs three sponsors who never vouched together before, so vouches must bridge a canyon between clusters, not come from one haven cluster. Each sponsor locks $40 for 60 days, backs at most five per epoch. Seven auditors recheck sponsor graphs weekly, and a proven fake burns all three sponsors' stakes plus its bond and wipes their budgets for two epochs. One honest agent ties up $120, loses nothing; 100 clones need 300 vouches from 60 sponsors, locking $12,000, and one caught clone torches its sponsors' batch. Trust runs one way like a river, never looping back to certify itself.
